DRAW_SPACE.CONSTRUCTION: all_main_draw_masks(49, 6) once, shared read-only by every worker

COMPONENT_IDENTITY.LOCAL_SLOT_CONVENTION: local slot k of a component is its k-th ticket in normalized baseline order

FAMILY_A_12_SIDE.DEFINITION: Freeze all 20 twelve-side F3 supports and the whole 8-side component; the six twelve-side F2 supports range over every perfect matching of the 12 slots.
FAMILY_A_12_SIDE.LABEL_ASSIGNMENT: ascending F2 labels to lexicographically sorted matching edges
FAMILY_A_12_SIDE.PARTNER_CODE_CONVENTION: character k is the base-36 local partner slot of local slot k

FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.DEFINITION: Freeze both eight-side F3 supports and the whole 12-side component; the 21 eight-side F2 supports range over every simple graph on the 8 slots whose F3-bearing slots have degree 5 and non-F3 slots have degree 6.
FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.LABEL_ASSIGNMENT: ascending F2 labels to lexicographically sorted graph edges
FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.MASK_CONVENTION: bit k is the k-th lexicographic pair of local slots 0..7
FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.AUTOMORPHISM_GROUP_DEFINITION: all permutations of the 8 local slots preserving the unordered pair of disjoint F3 triples and the unordered pair of non-F3 slots (filtered from all 8!)
FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.REPRESENTATIVE_RULE: least edge mask in the orbit; witness = first group element
FAMILY_B_8_SIDE.SLOT_PERMUTATION_CONVENTION: character v is the image of local slot v

COMPONENT_DECOMPOSITION_CROSSCHECK.METHOD: split every main draw into its 12-side and 8-side numbers and combine exact per-component non-winning counts and rescue sums

CLAIM_SCOPE: Closes only frozen-F3 twelve-side perfect-matching F2 rewires and frozen-F3 eight-side degree-constrained F2 rewires of the N2-closed 12+8 champion. No claim about all pairwise-overlap>1 designs or global K20 optimality.
